context: Three kind nodes on one laptop; Kubernetes 1.36.4; metrics-server 0.9.1 with test-only insecure kubelet TLS; real B2 us-west-002 dedicated bucket and scoped key; Woodpecker 18 static image sha256:9132851e1650dacb9ed7dabeba2e2ab70a4f5d2cd617dc851cdfcad64ffc5dba. A 2m CPU request is deliberately chosen to exercise HPA under cloud-latency-bound traffic, not a capacity recommendation. limitations: Disposable kind cluster on one physical host, not independent infrastructure failure domains.
CPU requests and HPA downscale windows are qualification settings, not capacity recommendations.
Single sequential append writer per database; no cross-client contested-register linearizability claim.
Short fault campaign; no sustained-load, AWS, or production SLO claim.
calibration_note: Stopped after successful fault injection because the 2m request was below background-maintenance CPU demand and did not allow scale-down. Repeated with an explicit 15m request; no capacity conclusion follows.
